newsitem.title: EGYPT: Private Egyptian firm expands steel billet project.
newsitem.headline: Private Egyptian firm expands steel billet project.

text.p: Al Ezz Steel Rebars, a member of the Egyptian private-sector Ezz Group, said on Friday the steel melting shop it plans to build in Sadat City northwest of Cairo would produce 600,000 tonnes of billets a year.
The billet plant will operate in conjunction with a new steel rolling mill for which Al Ezz signed a contract with the Italian company Danieli in September last year.
Under the original plan the complex would produce 400,000 tonnes of steel billets and 380,000 tonnes of rebars a year, at a total investment of about 350 million pounds ($100 million).
Al Ezz said the plan was now to award a contract for mechanical and electrical installations in the melting shop by April 1997 and the work should be complete by October 1997.
It invited companies to apply by November 15 for prequalification for the contract to supply the electric arc furnace, the ladle furnace and the continuous casting machine.
